title: Lost in Translation and Noise: A Deep Dive into the Failure Modes of VLMs on Real-World Tables

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a visual tabular question-answering benchmark (MirageTVQA) translated into 24 different languages to measure the exact match (EM) performance disparities and identify 'English-first' degradation in non-English and low-resource languages.
